title: Own profile after update v1
description: PATCH /api/v1/me/profile success data, carried as `data` inside http.success-envelope.v1. `user.name` is the stored, normalized display name: NFC, trimmed, 1-80 code points, no control, bidi, zero-width or line/paragraph separator characters, and no leading or trailing whitespace (the pattern). NFC form is guaranteed by the service and not expressible in JSON Schema. `user.id` is the server-owned Better Auth ID and `user.email` is read-only here; both repeat GET /api/v1/me.

email.description: Sign-in email as stored by the identity provider; not re-validated as an address.

name.description: Normalized display text. Render escaped; never an operator label.
